title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner Hudson signs with Bengals' active roster
items.desc: The Bengals signed TE Tanner Hudson to their active roster.
items.impact: Hudson will add depth in the tight end room for Cincinnati.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Davis placed on IR
items.desc: The Bengals placed CB Jalen Davis on injured reserve.
items.impact: Davis injured his hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Steelers. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Wypler could start at center for Browns Thursday
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken says Luke Wypler would start at center if Elgton Jenkins doesn't clear concussion protocol.
items.impact: It is a short week for Cleveland against the Steelers on Thursday. The status of Jenkins will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Watson suffers dislocated shoulder
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said CB Jaylen Watson dislocated his shoulder on Sunday.
items.impact: Watson is expected to avoid injured reserve. He is week-to-week as of now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) uncertain on practicing this week
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said there's no update on RB Zach Charbonnet.
items.impact: They are still deciding on whether Charbonnet will have his practice window opened this week. He can have it opened at any time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Julian Love (calf) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Julian Love is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Love did not play in Sunday's loss against the Commanders. "It's a day-to-day thing with Julian [Love]. Things went really well this morning."

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damien Lewis (elbow) to miss a few weeks
items.desc: Panthers G Damien Lewis will be out "a few weeks."
items.impact: It is another significant loss for Carolina. The Panthers will be without their starting guard on the offensive line for at least the next few weeks.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Eagles D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3
items.desc: The Eagles D/ST allowed 27 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: It was a poor performance by the Eagles on Monday night as they couldn't stop Case Keenum from carving them up. Keenum hadn't appeared in a regular-season game since 2023, but he tossed two touchdowns and ran for a third. The Eagles will look to regroup in a tough Week 4 matchup against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jake Elliott makes XP in Week 3
items.desc: Jake Elliott was held to one extra point in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Elliott did not attempt any field goals on a rough night for the Eagles on offense. The veteran kicker has now made both of his field-goal attempts and added seven extra points through three games this season. He will take on the Rams in Week 4.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Zach Ertz catches one pass in Week 3
items.desc: Zach Ertz caught one of his two targets for a nine-yard gain in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Ertz was signed off of the Eagles' practice squad earlier in the week and suited up for their Monday night matchup against Chicago. With Dallas Goedert (knee) likely a few weeks away from returning, Ertz should continue to operate as Philly's top tight end against the Rams in Week 4.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Makai Lemon catches three passes in Week 3
items.desc: Makai Lemon caught three of his four targets for 29 yards in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Lemon turned in his best game as a pro on Monday night, finishing third on the team in targets and second in catches. The rookie wideout has now caught seven passes for 38 yards through three games. He remains a bench stash in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks draws five targets in Week 3
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks caught two of his five targets for 32 yards in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Wicks finished second on the team in receiving yards on a rough evening for the Philly passing attack. The veteran wideout has been solid for the Eagles thus far, catching nine passes for 179 yards and a touchdown through three games. He will be a flex option in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: DeVonta Smith leads Eagles in receiving in Week 3
items.desc: DeVonta Smith caught six of his eight targets for 65 yards in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3's Monday night game.
items.impact: Smith led the Eagles in all receiving categories in the lopsided loss. The veteran wideout is off to a strong start to the year, catching 19 passes for 235 yards and a touchdown through three games. He will be a low-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tank Bigsby loses fumble in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Tank Bigsby caught his lone target for a five-yard gain in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Bigsby did not record any carries and lost a fumble on his lone catch of the contest. The veteran running back will look to bounce back in Week 4 against the Rams. He remains a solid fantasy handcuff moving forward.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Saquon Barkley runs for 82 yards in Week 3
items.desc: Saquon Barkley carried the ball 15 times for 82 yards and lost two yards on his lone catch in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Barkley was able to suit up and lead the Philadelphia backfield one week after suffering a shoulder stinger. He looked good in the contest, averaging 5.5 yards per carry for the Eagles. Still looking for his first touchdown of the season, Barkley has now gained 174 yards while catching three passes for six yards through three games. He will be a solid fantasy option in Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jalen Hurts runs for a TD, throws INT in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Jalen Hurts completed 16 of his 25 pass attempts for 153 yards and an interception while adding four rushes for 25 yards and a touchdown in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
items.impact: Hurts and the Philadelphia offense struggled in the loss to Chicago on Monday night. He briefly left the game to get checked for a concussion but was cleared to return to the contest shortly after. Hurts has thrown for 620 yards, five touchdowns, and three interceptions while adding 87 rushing yards and a touchdown on the ground in three games this season. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Bears D/ST excellent in Week 3 win
items.desc: The Bears D/ST allowed seven points while forcing three turnovers and notching two sacks in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
items.impact: Chicago's defense came to play in Week 3's Monday night game. They made things tough on the Philly offense, intercepting two passes and recovering a Tank Bigsby fumble. They will look to keep it going in Week 4 against the Jets.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Cairo Santos makes two FGs in Week 3
items.desc: Cairo Santos made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3's Monday night game.
items.impact: Santos hit field goals from 29 and 48 yards out in the decisive victory over Philadelphia. The veteran kicker has made four of his five field-goal attempts and added 11 extra points through three games this year. He will take on the Jets in Week 4.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Colston Loveland hauls in four balls in Week 3
items.desc: Colston Loveland caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3's Monday night game.
items.impact: Loveland got off to a quick start, bringing in a four-yard pass from Case Keenum on the second play of the game. The Week 3 effort goes down as Loveland's best of the season as he was shut out in Week 1 and held to three receiving yards in Week 2. He has now caught five passes for 34 yards through three games. Loveland will look to break out in Week 4 against the Jets.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kalif Raymond leads Bears in receiving in Week 3
items.desc: Kalif Raymond caught six of his seven targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
items.impact: Raymond's surprise involvement in the Chicago passing attack continues as he posted his most productive game of the season. The veteran wideout has caught 19 passes for 214 yards and a touchdown through three games while outproducing both Rome Odunze and Luther Burden III. Raymond will be a solid fantasy option in Week 4 against the Jets.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Rome Odunze goes for 44 yards in Week 3
items.desc: Rome Odunze caught three of his six targets for 44 yards in a 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.
items.impact: Odunze finished third on the Bears in targets and receiving yards but he was unable to find the end zone for the third straight game. The veteran wideout has been outproduced by both Luther Burden III and Kalif Raymond this season, catching just eight passes for 139 yards thus far through three games. He will be a fantasy flex option in Week 4 against the Jets.
